obligations.statement: create runs only when not_null(object); otherwise returns GF_STATUS_INVALID_ARGUMENT, unchanged.
Unless not_null(object), create changes nothing observable.
create runs only when not_null(table); otherwise returns GF_STATUS_INVALID_ARGUMENT, unchanged.
Unless not_null(table), create changes nothing observable.

The base function that base_raiser gives refuses, when it is called, an object not made from a class table or whose class chain lacks the entry's segment, with GF_STATUS_WRONG_HANDLE_KIND; base_raiser itself takes no object, so the refusal is the raiser's, not the slot's.
